page: Google Cloud Platform c4a-highmem-16-lssd is an Arm64-based server instance featuring 16 dedicated virtual CPUs and 128 GB of system memory. This configuration provides a memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8 GB per core, positioning it within the memory-optimized resource class. The instance operates on dedicated CPU allocations without hardware GPU acceleration.

While the instance configuration references NVMe SSD storage types, the local storage capacity is designated as none. The Arm64 architecture offers a design optimized for resource density, delivering qualitative cost efficiency for workloads requiring substantial memory capacity relative to compute cores without the overhead of traditional x86 architectures.

This server configuration is suited for memory-intensive workloads that benefit from dedicated Arm64 processing cores. Suitable applications include medium-sized databases, in-memory caching systems, data buffering, and enterprise applications requiring a 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio.
